Hey! First of all I want to say it's really cute/sweet of you to receive an appeal from you after my inactivity from this site, it genuinely means it feels like you want to draw my cat boy! 1000 thanks to you

Also, the amount I put is the amount the appeal says? I'm not sure if its a mistake aha, but if it isn't I am again very humbled by the generosity

Im not sure if you want instruction or to just do with my catboy as you please but https://imgur.com/a/LfVyMNo here are some refs!

If possible id like a piece that highlights that he is a ghost/"Cheshire Cat" by having him do something spooky/be in a spooky place. phasing through walls, doing a "boo" or something surprise the viewer! he is a very mischievous boy! I urge you to go as wild on that concept as you want to

But failing that, you're free to do anything you want with him, something more relaxed or sleepy in a bedroom or something would be good too.

whichever thing is what you prefer to draw really!
